from __future__ import annotations

import uuid

import httpx


async def test_whitebox_bookmarks_flow(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    email = f"unit_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com"
    reg = await client.post(
        "/api/auth/register",
        json={"email": email, "password": "pass1234", "name": "Unit"},
    )
    assert reg.status_code == 201

    login = await client.post(
        "/api/auth/login",
        json={"email": email, "password": "pass1234"},
    )
    assert login.status_code == 200
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {login.json()['access_token']}"}

    created = await client.post(
        "/api/bookmarks",
        headers=headers,
        json={"url": "https://example.org", "title": "Example", "tags": ["ref"]},
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201

    tags = await client.get("/api/tags", headers=headers)
    assert tags.status_code == 200
    assert tags.json()["items"] == [{"name": "ref", "count": 1}]
